```{r}

num_df_final_id <- oculina_final[, c(6, 40:16396)]
  
```

```{r}
```

```{r}
Oculina_long <- num_df_final_id |>
  pivot_longer(-id,
               names_to = "Metabolite",
               values_to = "Abundance")
```

```{r}
Oculina_joined <- Oculina_long %>%
  left_join(feats_with_classes %>%
              select(metabolite, compound_class),
            by = c("Metabolite" = "metabolite"))
```

```{r}
Oculina_class <- Oculina_joined %>%
  group_by(id, compound_class) %>%
  summarise(Total_Abundance = sum(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
Oculina_class_wide <- Oculina_class %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = compound_class,
              values_from = Total_Abundance)
            #  values_fill = 0)
```

entropy, richness, evenness:

```{r}
write.csv(ocu_fin_div, file = "oculina_final_diversity.csv")
```

```{r}
#ocu_fin_div <- read.csv("oculina_final_diversity.csv")

ocu_fin_div <- ocu_fin_div |>
  mutate(Phenotype = bleaching) |>
    mutate(Phenotype = recode(Phenotype,
                              "B" = "Aposymbiotic",
                              "NB" = "Symbiotic"))

ggplot(ocu_fin_div, aes(x = Phenotype, y = Richness, fill = Phenotype)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Aposymbiotic" = "orange", "Symbiotic" = "blue")) +
  theme_minimal() +
   geom_point(
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.2,   # stay within each box
      jitter.height = 0,
      dodge.width  = 1,     
    ), 
    
    shape = 21,               # fill + outline
    color = "black",          # outline
    stroke = 0.45,
    size = 1,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  
  stat_compare_means(aes(group = Phenotype), 
                     method = "kruskal.test", 
                     label = "p.format",
                     ) 
```
